title: Article Contained in The Sin Wan Pao Dated August 1931

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. D. REGISTRY No. S. B. D. 2464 Date August 8, 1931）

Subject (in full) Article contained in the Sin Wan Pao dated August 8, 1931

Made by ________________ and ________________ Forwarded by C.D.I. Robertson

With reference to the Article appearing in the Sin
Wan Pao and other local Chinese newspapers of August 8, 1931
to the effect that according to a Shanghai telegram received
by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs at Nanking from its office
in Shanghai, the dead body of the missing English youth
Thorburn has been found in Soochow but that the cause of death
is unknown, inquiries made at the local office of the Ministry
Affairs learn from the Secretary Mr. Yan; that he knows nothing
whatever about the telegram. Enquiries at the local office of
the "China Times" (which paper also publishes the information)
show that the news was received by telegram from the office of
the paper in Nanking and beyond that they know nothing about
the affair.

Henry Robertson
C. D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（左侧边注：y. Robertson / Robertson / Jcd）
（手写批注：Copy of this report with newspaper
8/8 translation attached sent to Mr. Hough
in accordance with verbal instruction
of the D. C. Irvine.
HR. 8/8.）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事与特别科登记处 编号 S. B. D. 2464 日期 1931年8月8日）

事由（全称） 1931年8月8日《新闻报》所载文章

由 ___ 及 ___ 编制，经刑事侦缉督察罗伯逊（C.D.I. Robertson）转呈

关于1931年8月8日《新闻报》及其他本地中文报纸上刊登的一篇文章，文中称：据南京外交部从其上海办事处收到的一封上海电报称，失踪的英国青年索伯恩（Thorburn）的尸体已在苏州被发现，但死因不明。经向外交部本地办事处查询，从秘书严先生（Mr. Yan）处获悉，他对上述电报一事毫不知情。经向《时报》（该报亦发布了此消息）本地办事处查询，得知该消息系由其南京办事处通过电报发来，除此之外他们对此事一无所知。

亨利·罗伯逊（Henry Robertson）
刑事侦缉督察

特别科科长。

（左侧边注：y. Robertson / Robertson / Jcd）
（手写批注：根据欧文副总巡（D. C. Irvine）的口头指示，已将本报告副本连同所附8月8日报纸译文一并送交霍夫先生（Mr. Hough）。
HR. 8/8。）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. I. RECORDS
S. B. D. 2464
5. 8. 31.

Special Branch,
August 5, 1931.

D.C. (Crime),

There is an item in the French Police
Intelligence Report of August 4 to the effect that
local Soviet circles are in possession of information
confirming that J. Thorburn is dead, and that three
Russians, who have not yet been identified, were
assassinated at the same time. The local G.P.U. has started
an investigation on this subject under the direction of
V.N. Rojelsky alias Raevsky.

J. Givens
O. i/c Sp. Br.

Sc. to
Information

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别科档案
S. B. D. 2464
1931年8月5日

特别科，
1931年8月5日。

致副巡捕长（刑事），

法国警察情报报告8月4日刊有一则消息，称本地苏维埃圈子掌握信息，证实J. 索伯恩（J. Thorburn）已死亡，同时有三名尚未查明身份的俄罗斯人被暗杀。本地国家政治保卫局（G.P.U.）已在V.N. 罗热尔斯基（V.N. Rojelsky），化名拉耶夫斯基（Raevsky）的指导下，就此事项展开调查。

J. 吉文斯（J. Givens）
特别科主管

抄送
情报科
8月5日
